release.notes: Kia Niro EV 64.8: ECU scan and fault codes disabled after reports of a shift to neutral; safer clearing of fault codes (read first, erase only units with codes); car info dialog; arrival SoC on the Drive SOC tile during navigation; live stream no longer loses data; demo mode and connection fixes; about 3,100 more texts translated. Cars: BMW iX3, Volt/Ampera Gen1 SoH, Mach-E DC power, Geely SEA charging, Ariya, e-Boxer, Elroq, C-HR+, XPeng P7+.
